title: Filipino Keto BBQ Pork Skewers
description: A twist on traditional Filipino BBQ, this keto-friendly version uses pork skewers and a sweet and spicy sauce. Perfect as a dinner or snack.

ingredients.name: Pork shoulder, cut into 1-inch cubes
ingredients.notes: Make sure to buy a keto-friendly cut of pork

ingredients.name: Dish dashi powder
ingredients.notes: Optional, but adds depth of flavor

ingredients.name: QQ garlic powder
ingredients.notes: Optional, but adds a savory flavor

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, balsamic vinegar, dashi powder, garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Add the pork cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated pork onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, or until the pork is cooked through.
Brush the skewers with more olive oil if needed during grilling.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with chopped cilantro.
